transcribed.note: Values stated in the text of Sections 4.3.2, 4.3.3 and 5.3. Reported by the study on its own testbed; not measured here.
transcribed.guideline: If the task has a strict, microsecond-level latency constraint, a distance-based estimator must be selected, as it is the only viable option.
transcribed.task_description: binary latency classification (fast/slow) for each I/O
transcribed.fallback: a flagged request is dispatched to both SSDs simultaneously; the redundant request is cancelled on the first response

read_from_figure_10.note: ESTIMATES. Our reading of the right-hand plot of Figure 10 (read latency against percentile), to about 0.05 ms, from the published PDF rendered at 400 dpi. The study states no values for hedging. As a check on the reading, 1 - 1.00/2.33 = 57%, the cut the study states for its gates.
